newsitem.title: USA: Mont. Colstrip 3 power plant restarts, 1 back Fri.
newsitem.headline: Mont. Colstrip 3 power plant restarts, 1 back Fri.

text.p: The 700 megawatt (MW) unit 3 at the Colstrip coal-fired power plant near Billings, Mont., was restarted Sunday, slightly ahead of schedule, sources at the plant said Monday.
Colstrip's 330 MW unit 1, which has been down for work on its cooling tower since early last week, is expected to be back up by Friday, they said.
Colstrip units 2 (330 MW) and 4 (700 MW) were said to be operating normally.
Montana Power Co operates the Colstrip plant and is responsible for the sale of 30 percent of unit 4's output under long-term contracts.

Equity owners include Puget Sound Power and Light Co, Washington Water Power Co, Portland General Electric Co, Pacific Power and Light, and a consortium of GE Credit, Shell Oil Co and a lease-back firm.
